decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork system closely tied to the firm's core prefabrication equipment offering, it is likely to stay unless replaced by a newer generation.
This flow-control product supports the firm's strategic push toward automation, although its lower standalone visibility leaves some risk that it is absorbed into broader system packages.
The magnetic formwork strip line fits the firm's modular product logic well and is likely to be retained, with only moderate risk from portfolio streamlining.
This magnetic formwork component remains relevant to the firm's tailored factory solutions, but overlap within the magnetic accessory range raises a somewhat higher rationalization risk.

Because it has the weakest web prominence and appears most likely to overlap with other magnetic formwork components, we would discontinue it and shift resources to stronger core products and new developments.
